summary: Post-R269 plus Local P07 patch Noether support package for Papers 26-28. It applies one source-certain German correction to Paper 27, restoring the source-visible leading em dash before the E. Noether item, while Papers 26 and 28 are visually checked with no TeX patch.
base: WebR269 plus LocalCodex P10/P20/P14/P13/P07 source patches.

applied_patch.fix: Prefix the Paper 27 item with TeX em dash marker `--- \textsc{E. Noether}: Hilbertsche Anzahlen in der Idealtheorie.` because the source introduces the Noether entry with an em dash separator.

no_patch_checks: P26 visually checked against printed page 102; item number, title, author/location, and abstract body survive while surrounding non-Noether abstracts remain excluded.
P28 visually checked against printed page 144; item number, title, author/location, and abstract body survive while surrounding non-Noether entries remain excluded.
public_caveats: This is a targeted source-patch and short visual-audit support package, not Paper 26/Paper 27/Paper 28 certification.
The source pages are clean native GDZ full-page witnesses but declared at 600 ppi, below the strict native650 preference.
The package does not claim that resampling or zoom splits create additional source information.
No multilingual synchronization, whole-Noether closure, source closure, or critical-edition claim is implied.
Because the Noether record is at the Zenodo file ceiling, fold this into a compact current-control/source-audit rebalance rather than loose-uploading it above reader PDFs/TeX.
recommended_action: Promote the P27 dash patch into the next compact German current-control rollup; keep the package as support/provenance and do not front it as a reader edition.
